title: Choking — cannot breathe or speak
scenario: Person is choking on food or an object. Cannot talk, cough, or breathe; clutching the throat; face turning red or blue.
steps: Ask 'Are you choking?' If they can cough or speak, encourage coughing and stay close.
If they cannot breathe, cough, or speak: call 911 or have someone call.
Give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.
Give 5 abdominal thrusts: stand behind them, fist above the navel, pull sharply inward and upward.
Alternate 5 back blows and 5 thrusts until the object comes out.
If they collapse, lower them to the ground and start CPR; look in the mouth before breaths and remove the object only if you can see it.
do_not: Do not offer anything to drink while they are choking.
Do not sweep the mouth blindly with a finger.
